verdict.rationale: Granola's own docs say transcription and generated summaries support multiple languages: 31 on desktop and 17 on mobile. That covers the 'many languages' core of the story. Nothing in the pack shows how it handles switching languages mid-meeting, and there is no independent or hands-on check of non-English accuracy. Missing for 10: documented handling of language switching within a meeting, the language list and accuracy details, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-English transcription and summary quality.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run meetings in languages other than English — transcription and summaries support many languages and handle language switching

citations.quote: Granola supports multiple languages for transcription and generated meeting summaries.
Granola supports 31 languages on desktop (macOS and Windows) and 17 languages on mobile (iOS and Android).
